title: Building Simple API Endpoints
summary: A minimal PHP endpoint validates input, talks to the database with PDO, and returns JSON plus the correct HTTP status.
objectives: Map HTTP methods to safe handlers
Keep secrets and SQL off the client

content.md: Start with routing (even a single `api/posts.php`), set `Content-Type: application/json`, validate method, then use prepared statements. Use **400** for bad input, **404** for missing resources, **500** only for unexpected failures (log details server-side).
